answer: Operator-Linked Identity Escrow: each agent identity posts a small refundable deposit drawn from a shared operator balance, and a contested sybil cluster triggers a proportional debit against that entire balance, not the flagged wallets. The operator absorbs full replacement cost per identity, so N fake agents cost N deposits plus forfeiture of the common pool. A periodic echo check re-verifies operator linkage, flagging anomalies like duplicate nebula routing signatures. Disputes settle against a shale-committed audit log, making withdrawals slow enough that detection outpaces escape.
